camel_example: aliyun ndr DisableBlocking --region cn-hangzhou --Entities.1.BlockingType ip --Entities.1.BlockingEntity '203.0.113.10' --version 2024-01-24 --method POST --force
description_en: Creates unblocking tasks in batches for specified entities while retaining existing blocking policies
description_zh: 为指定实体批量创建解封任务，保留已有封禁策略
kebab_example: aliyun ndr disable-blocking --entities BlockingType=ip BlockingEntity=203.0.113.10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DisableBlocking

fields.help_en: Required. The blocked object. For the ip type, it must be a single IPv4 address. IPv6 addresses, CIDR blocks, and 0.0.0.0 are not supported. For the domain type, it must be a domain name. IP literals and the wildcard character (*) are not supported. The domain name must contain a dot and cannot exceed 253 bytes in length
fields.help_zh: 必填。封禁对象。ip 类型须为单个 IPv4 地址，不支持 IPv6、CIDR 或 0.0.0.0；domain 类型须为域名，不支持 IP 字面值或通配符 *，须包含点，长度不超过 253 字节
fields.name: blocking_entity

fields.help_en: Required. The object type. Only ip (IPv4 address) and domain (domain name) are supported
fields.help_zh: 必填。封禁对象类型，仅支持 ip（IPv4）或 domain（域名）
fields.name: blocking_type

parameters.help_en: The array of entities to be operated on. The array must contain 1 to 100 items. Do not submit duplicate combinations of type and entity
parameters.help_zh: 待操作实体数组，必须包含 1～100 项；请勿重复提交相同类型和实体组合
parameters.name: entities

schema.description_en: The processing result of the request

Data.description_en: The business result returned by the operation
Data.description_zh: 本次操作返回的业务结果

SuccessCount.description_en: The number of entity items for which unblocking tasks are successfully created in this request. This is not the number of tasks and does not indicate that the unblocking operations are complete. A bidirectional entity is counted as one item, but two tasks are created
SuccessCount.description_zh: 本次成功创建解封任务的实体项数量，不是任务条数，也不表示已完成解封。双向实体计 1 项，但创建 2 条任务

TaskItems.description_en: The list of unblocking tasks created in this request. For bidirectional entities, two tasks for the in and out directions are returned
TaskItems.description_zh: 本次创建的解封任务列表，双向实体分别返回 in 和 out 两条任务

items.description_en: An asynchronous task created in this request
items.description_zh: 一条本次新建的异步任务信息

BlockingDirection.description_en: The direction of the asynchronous task. in indicates the inbound direction, and out indicates the outbound direction. Bidirectional operations are split into two tasks
BlockingDirection.description_zh: 本条异步任务的方向，in 表示入方向，out 表示出方向；双向操作拆成两条任务

BlockingEntity.description_en: The IPv4 address or domain name of the blocked object
BlockingEntity.description_zh: 封禁对象的 IPv4 地址或域名

BlockingType.description_en: The object type. ip indicates an IPv4 address, and domain indicates a domain name
BlockingType.description_zh: 封禁对象类型。ip 表示 IPv4 地址，domain 表示域名

TaskType.description_en: The type of the task. The value is fixed to 2, which indicates manual unblocking
TaskType.description_zh: 本条任务的类型，固定为 2，表示手动解封

TaskUuid.description_en: The UUID of the create task node. You can pass it to the TaskUuids parameter of DescribeBlockingTaskStatus to query the execute result
TaskUuid.description_zh: 本条新建任务的 UUID，可传入 DescribeBlockingTaskStatus 的 TaskUuids 查询执行结果

TotalCount.description_en: The number of entity items in the Entities request parameter, including the items that are skipped in this request
TotalCount.description_zh: 请求 Entities 中的实体项数量，包含本次被跳过的项

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails. An empty string is returned if the request is successful. The example InvalidParam indicates that the request parameters are invalid and does not represent an error code for a successful response
ErrorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时的错误码；成功时为空字符串。示例 InvalidParam 表示请求参数无效，不代表成功响应的错误码

Message.description_en: The result description of the request. The value is success if the request is successful, or an error description if the request fails
Message.description_zh: 本次请求的结果说明；成功时为 success，失败时返回错误说明

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to troubleshoot and locate this request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于排查和定位本次请求

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the API call is successful. true indicates that the request is processed successfully, and false indicates that the request fails. For asynchronous APIs, a success status does not indicate that the task execution is complete
Success.description_zh: 本次接口调用是否成功。true 表示请求处理成功，false 表示失败；异步接口的成功不表示任务已经执行完成
